npcs.name: Veteran Iris
npcs.meet_text: Me and my husband used to go everywhere, all over the world, but we've slowed down since moving here. It's peaceful here and it makes you appreciate the smaller things
npcs.repeat_text: The world is large and there's a lot in it, but even this forest itself is a world of it's own, full of life entirely self contained that will never leave it's boundaries.

opponents.name: Clown Hubert
opponents.meet_text: Can you believe that some people are actually scared of us clowns!!!
opponents.repeat_text: I'm glad you don't find me scary!
opponents.first_win_text: I ran away from the circus for this?
opponents.rematch_win_text: I wonder if the circus will take me back....
opponents.loss_text: *honk* *honk* I can teach you how to ride a unicycle

opponents.name: Clown Glenn
opponents.meet_text: Why do clowns often have stiff necks?....
opponents.repeat_text: I told my wife I was going to clown college....
opponents.rematch_win_text: ..... She said you can't be serious!!!

opponents.name: Rocket Exec Petrel
opponents.meet_text: Heh, you've found us at the right time. We've been hiding from the police... Not that we've done anything illegal, we're just here to play this card game.
opponents.rematch_win_text: You should join us, we've got big things coming.
opponents.loss_text: Of course you didn't stand a chance against us.

opponents.name: Rocket Exec Proton
opponents.meet_text: This well is bringing back a lot of memories... I can't imagine you've heard of Team Rocket before but you'll hear about us soon.
opponents.first_win_text: Heh we're in your shadow then huh.
opponents.rematch_win_text: It won't always be like this.

opponents.name: Rocket Exec Archer
opponents.meet_text: Hello. I'm Archer one of the 4 execs of Team Rocket. We're not here to do anything illicit. Not yet anyway. We're just getting started.
opponents.repeat_text: If you're really that interested you should join us.
opponents.first_win_text: Enjoy the wins while they last.

opponents.name: Rocket Exec Ariana
opponents.meet_text: Have you bought any of our card packs yet? Boss wants us to make as much money as possible as soon as we can.
opponents.repeat_text: You got one pack free but I won't be giving you another.
opponents.first_win_text: Here's a free one on me. Don't expect any more though.
opponents.rematch_win_text: Don't ask for anything from us.

opponents.name: Rocket Boss Giovanni
opponents.meet_text: Good evening. I believe we may have already met? I've been working tirelessly since I arrived. There seems to be a lot of money to be made in this card game.
opponents.repeat_text: Nice to see you again. I'm willing to play again.
opponents.first_win_text: Interesting. You've got a great technique.
opponents.rematch_win_text: You could teach me a thing or two about this.
opponents.loss_text: Hmm. I won't let you beat me.

opponents.name: Veteran Sylvester
opponents.meet_text: We've travelled the world together and settled here recently. We've been aboard the SS Anne before and it looks like it hasn't changed in years.
opponents.repeat_text: Good evening, hope you're keeping well.
opponents.first_win_text: You already appear well travelled. Maybe you could join us on our next adventure.
opponents.loss_text: Don't let this get you down.

opponents.name: Psychic Nova
opponents.meet_text: If you relax your thoughts and focus your mind entirely, some people can move objects with natural telekinetic powers.
opponents.first_win_text: My friend can bring out your hidden powers.
opponents.rematch_win_text: You have great potential. I think you have what it takes.
opponents.loss_text: You'll never be a master of your mind if you don't focus.

opponents.name: Psychic Eli
opponents.meet_text: I can teach you to unleash your hidden potential. You have to be ready to empty your mind, focus and concentrate.
opponents.repeat_text: I am now able speak to you through your mind without the need to talk.
opponents.first_win_text: You have the power. Focus. Direct. Start small and train hard.
opponents.rematch_win_text: You have great potential. I think you have what it takes.
opponents.loss_text: I was wrong. You lack the discipline it takes.

opponents.name: Light Engineer Chase
opponents.meet_text: My boss called me out to fix these lights but I arrived and they're all working? What a waste of my time but at least I'm being paid so fancy a match?
opponents.repeat_text: I can't leave this early or I won't be paid
opponents.first_win_text: Being paid to be beaten, well I'm not complaining.
opponents.loss_text: Well I'm glad I didn't have to do any work now!
